scientific_question: Does the natural patch representation preserve uniquely useful task-structured 2D image-space object, EE-object-relative, or interaction geometry that frozen global CLIP pooling loses?

frozen_upstream.transitive_ledger: The frozen natural-spatial, visual-target, structured-state, and matched-branch protocols transitively hash-check C0-v2, C1-v2.1 candidate generation and production scale, D13/D14/D15, WM-v2A/B/B.1/C-EJ, all reports/results/checkpoints, and the exact natural RGB futures.

scope.bootstrap_and_split_unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all three candidate pairs and eight horizons

calibration.use: camera validation, target construction, leave-one-init-out CV, fit, and coefficient freeze

development_evaluation.use: one-shot frozen development evaluation; explicitly not blind or confirmatory

natural_image_contract.global_feature: same frozen natural-image visual_projection plus L2 normalization [512]
natural_image_contract.patch_feature: same natural image last_hidden_state[:,1:] -> post_layernorm -> visual_projection -> per-token L2 normalization [49,512]

camera_projection.inventory_partition: calibration init31 only for all ten tasks before target construction
camera_projection.selection: choose the convention with lower median projected-EE distance to natural robot segmentation; exact tie favors direct_render

image_space_targets.coordinate_normalization: u/image_width and v/image_height; projected EE is not clipped
image_space_targets.object_aggregation: retain both runtime obj_of_interest slots and use calibration-frozen maximum across valid object-wise scalar magnitudes
image_space_targets.invisible_object_rule: visibility=0; area and mask metrics remain defined; centroid/relative targets are invalid and never imputed
image_space_targets.ee_image_displacement: L2 norm of candidate-pair projected EE coordinate difference
image_space_targets.object_centroid_displacement: maximum normalized image centroid displacement among objects visible in both candidates
image_space_targets.object_mask_difference: maximum full-image symmetric-difference fraction among per-object natural semantic masks; object-wise 1-IoU is retained diagnostically
image_space_targets.visible_area_difference: maximum absolute full-image visible-area-fraction difference; relative area change is diagnostic only with denominator floor 1/(128*128)
image_space_targets.relative_image_displacement: maximum norm of pair difference in (object centroid - projected EE)
image_space_targets.ee_object_distance_change: maximum absolute change in object-centroid to projected-EE distance
image_space_targets.strict_proximity_change: maximum absolute change in projected-EE to natural object-mask distance divided by the image diagonal
image_space_targets.robot_object_adjacency_change: maximum absolute change in fraction of object-boundary pixels within a square dilation radius of the natural robot mask

representations.global_10d: exact frozen global_summary from natural-spatial audit
representations.patch_10d: exact frozen patch_summary from natural-spatial audit; broad historical interaction component is unchanged
representations.strict_interaction_secondary: one new scalar: natural patch distance weighted by relevant-object fractional coverage and Gaussian distance to projected EE, sigma 16px
representations.signed_pca16: exact frozen calibration-fit global and patch PCA16; secondary only

probes.model: independent closed-form ridge regression with intercept
probes.selection: leave-one-init-state-out CV within init31-34; minimum mean RMSE; exact tie favors larger alpha

shuffle.rule: derange named feature group across branch points within identical task, horizon, and candidate pair

bootstrap.unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all 24 correlated rows

gates.increment_ci_rule: G+P versus G relative RMSE improvement CI lower > 0
gates.patch_shuffle_rule: full-patch shuffle degradation >0 and CI lower >0
gates.target_pass: all aggregate increment, CI, full-patch shuffle, task, horizon, and pair checks pass

comparison_to_3d.mismatch_rule: a mapped 2D target must pass the complete primary gate and exceed the corresponding frozen 3D increment by at least 2 percentage points

candidate_headroom_reference.interpretation: even if representation limitations are resolved, the current candidate set offers modest imitation-oriented headroom and no controller-success claim

decision.if_unresolved: do not run a third similar representation probe; reconsider the prediction-verified reranking premise and the frozen candidate-headroom constraint

forbidden: Do not access init40-49, reward, done, success, task outcome, or controller outcome.
Do not use modified/masked RGB or masked CLIP inference as primary or secondary input.
Do not train or modify CLIP, any World Model, actor, candidate generator, scale, reranker, or controller.
Do not run C1/C2, D20-v2, seed23/47, controller success, or a patch World Model.
Do not overwrite any upstream artifact; simulator replay is restricted to empirically validating the camera and collecting missing per-object natural masks.
Do not alter the frozen 10-D global or patch summaries or lower the 10% redesign threshold.
